{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
df_qa = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders found: {len(df_qa)}")

# Identify refunded orders
df_refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(df_refunded)}")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude QA orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Check distinct channels
print("Distinct channels in filtered data:", df_filtered['channel'].unique())

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
print("Total revenue by channel:", total_revenue_by_channel.to_dict('records'))"}
